info.name: Lynq Feeders
info.description: Endpoints of the lynq-feeders service, the FastAPI job-listing feeder that scrapes the job portals (bumeran, computrabajo), asks lynq-llm to extract skills from each posting, ingests the batch into lynq-app-backend and later checks whether ingested postings are still live. It is a ClusterIP service with no Ingress and no bearer auth: reach it through `kubectl port-forward svc/lynq-feeders-service 8089:8089`. Every request except the health probe requires the `lynq-request-uuid` header (403 without it); requests with a body also send `Content-Type: application/json`.

exec: // Generate a fresh request UUID per call so log tracing stays unique.

request.description: Liveness/readiness probe used by the Kubernetes Deployment; it is the only route exempt from the `lynq-request-uuid` header. Always answers 200 and reports whether lynq-llm and lynq-app-backend are reachable (`UP`/`DOWN`) instead of failing when they are not.

Starts a full feed run with the configured sources, categories and jobs per category, exactly as the daily CronJob does, and answers 202 with no body (409 if a run is already in progress). Warning: it scrapes the live job portals, calls lynq-llm for every posting and writes the result into lynq-app-backend; follow it in the pod logs by request uuid.

On-demand feed run narrowed to the given sources (`bumeran`, `computrabajo`), categories (e.g. ADMINISTRACION, TECNOLOGIA, CONTABILIDAD, RECURSOS HUMANOS; unmapped ones fall back to a keyword search) and `jobs_per_category` (1-50); every field is optional. Answers 202 with no body, 400 for an unknown source or out-of-range field, 409 if a run is in progress. Warning: it scrapes the live portals and writes into lynq-app-backend.

Starts a liveness check of previously ingested postings across every configured source, as the daily CronJob does right after the ingest; the run waits for any ingest in progress. Answers 202 with no body (409 if a verify run is already in progress). Warning: it requests the live portal pages and closes gone postings in lynq-app-backend.

On-demand liveness check limited to the given sources (`bumeran`, `computrabajo`); postings of other sources are left for the next run. Answers 202 with no body, 400 for an unknown source, 409 if a verify run is in progress. Warning: it requests the live portal pages and closes gone postings in lynq-app-backend.
